FreeFine Final Geometry — Step 0 v2: Exact GeoBench Affine Audit

**Correction to v1.** The `sample_metadata.csv::scale_change` field belongs to the thesis diagnostic metadata and is **not** the raw resize factor used by FreeFine. Likewise, its `difficulty` field is the thesis diagnostic stratification, not the paper's original easy/medium/hard instruction label. Therefore v1 correctly stopped with `AUDIT STATUS: FAIL`, and its router config must not be used.

This v2 reads the **exact `edit_param` used by the official FreeFine inference pipeline**. In the official code the tuple is unpacked as
`dx, dy, dz, rx, ry, rz, sx, sy, sz = edit_param`, with `(sx, sy)` used directly as the resize scale.

No model inference. No GPU. No metric tuning.

FreeFine Final Geometry — Step 0: GeoBench-2D Audit & Router Freeze

**Purpose:** before the full 5,677-sample end-to-end final runs, verify the exact GeoBench-2D population and derive/validate a deployable resize-severity rule from the requested geometric transform (not from oracle benchmark labels).

This notebook performs **no model inference and needs no GPU**. It does not tune on generated-image metrics.

Expected GeoBench-2D population used in the thesis reproduction: **5,677 edits = 1,439 move + 1,603 rotate + 2,635 resize**.

FreeFine Final Geometry — Step 1: Deployable Router Preflight (balanced-200)

This is a **cheap preflight only**, not the final benchmark evaluation. It uses the already-generated balanced-200 outputs to verify that the newly frozen **exact-affine** resize rule behaves sensibly before spending GPU quota on the full 5,677 end-to-end run.

Important methodological point: the earlier `resize_hard` gains were measured on the thesis diagnostic tertile. Step 0 v2 showed that this diagnostic label is not identical to the deployable affine severity rule. Therefore we must evaluate the **actual final routing rule once** before the expensive full run.

No image generation is performed here. The notebook reconstructs the two proposed pipelines from already-generated outputs and runs the official 7 metrics on the standard balanced-200 development set.
Phase 2/2b controllability sweep on balanced-200: start_step, start_layer and prompt-CFG variants including ss25/30/40/45, l4/8/12 and p7.5/p10.
